'''Topatz Shipping''' was a shipping corporation based on the [[Dravian Starport]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], they were looking for independent [[free-trader]]s to transport one hundred [[Metric ton/Legends|tons]] of imitation [[Gemstone/Legends|gemstones]] from Dravian Starport to the trade [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Bazaar (planet)|Bazaar]]. Topatz was willing to pay 4,500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for the job.
